g.title: MCU
g.text: Logical MCU terminal group only; actual physical pin/header connector not specified. MCU ground pins represent the same 0V net.

g.title: W_CTRL
g.text: 4 black wires identified as black 1..4 in source. Gauge/length not given.

g.title: W_SENSOR
g.text: Factory leads assumed as depicted; actual termination and length unspecified. White free end insulated.

g.title: W_GND
g.text: Color and wire gauge not specified; explicitly joins ESP32 GND to 24V/driver GND.

g.title: DRV_CTRL
g.text: Terminal order per source drawing. ENA pins are not connected.

g.title: DRV_PWR
g.text: At +V: 24V red and sensor brown. At GND: 24V black, sensor blue and MCU common GND. Confirm permissible multi-wire terminations.

g.title: W_MOTOR
g.text: Lead colors per attached PDF. Gauge/length not given.

g.title: MOTOR
g.text: Motor lead coil assignments copied from source; verify actual motor datasheet before energizing.

g.title: SUPPLY
g.text: Source unspecified (battery / DC-DC). Fuse/switch wiring and current rating not documented.

g.title: W_PWR
g.text: Thick black and thick red in source; numeric gauge/length not specified.

g.title: SENSOR
g.text: Four pre-attached wire colors copied from source. NC white lead is insulated and left unconnected.
